title: Minimax Inference for Concurrent Survival Effects in Platform Trials with Short Treatment Windows
banked_reason: D0.5 kernel_substituted: the promised full-class equality frontier and certified decision programs were not delivered.
gap_reasons: The proposed full-class strict-gain-versus-equality frontier (with certified values) has been replaced by a crude sufficient strict-gain region; the core itself leaves the equality frontier unresolved, so this is not the promised borrowing-frontier theorem.

The all-control headline value is only an infimum over unspecified randomized interval kernels; no finite grid/decision program, convergence scheme, or error certificate makes the claimed convolution value evaluable, despite the stated computational deliverable.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved a sound unknown-center adaptation companion, including local risk and interval identities, a feasible attainment argument, and a sufficient open strict-gain region. D0.5 found that this substituted the original known-center full-class equality frontier and omitted certified finite decision programs. A future run would need exact least-favorable priors and interval saddlepoints plus convergent, error-certified programs for the promised values.
tldr: A focal treatment observed only during a \(\lambda n^{-1/3}\) calendar window leaves its two baseline hazards estimable only at the RMST target scale. Under conditional randomization of the full potential event processes, the concurrent causal RMST is identified and the four-center local experiment has a nonzero adaptation price relative to the known-center benchmark. Concurrent-only squared-error inference pays two Gaussian location variances, whereas all-control inference learns the control center super-critically and pays one treatment-location variance plus bounded control-drift risk. For connected honest intervals, the exact unknown-center values are \(2z_\alpha\sqrt{\sigma_0^2+\sigma_1^2}\) in concurrent-only mode and a single treated-noise/control-drift convolution program in all-control mode; both strictly exceed their known-center benchmarks. Data-only procedures attain the values on every fixed center-score compact, and conservative mixing gives exact coverage on a selected slowly growing compact that eventually contains every fixed compact.
gap: D'Alessandro, Adhikari, and Santacatterina's Theorem 1 and Definition 2 identify fixed-window concurrent survival and RMST, but do not study four critical-rate unknown hazard centers. Qian et al.'s Section 3.3 gives fixed-hyperparameter Gaussian-process variance and RKHS bias guarantees, not an excess minimax risk over a known-center benchmark. The neighboring repository frontier varies the window exponent with tangent centers fixed.
fill: The project identifies the two-period causal RMST under full-process conditional randomization, defines the two finite source experiments and their observation sigma-fields, proves fixed-compact mixed-information convergence with an unbounded-risk transfer, derives exact adaptation-price identities, constructs source-measurable attaining rules, and gives an explicit exterior-support region where controls reduce the adaptation price.
